name: Army Soldier
notes: Infantry variants: Medic (+3 Medicine); Radio Operator/Drone Pilot (+3 Systems and Cyber); SRV/Tank Driver (+3 Vehicle Piloting); Combat Engineer (+3 Repair).

name: Slave Soldier
notes: Variants: Medic (+3 Medicine); Radio Operator/Drone Pilot (+3 Systems and Cyber).

name: Battlescarred Cyber Merc
notes: Continuous Attack.

name: The Don
notes: Eat Lead Sucker!: on a hit with a Burst weapon, inflicts maximum Burst damage.

name: Consigliere
notes: Dual Fire: fires two autopistols simultaneously at no penalty. Blur of Steel: +2 to a Melee attack roll. Hard Boiled: make two ranged attacks; Defence (Dodge) is 10 until the start of its next turn.

name: Police Detective
notes: Dive Aside: +5 to Defence (Dodge). Eat Lead Sucker!: inflict maximum Burst damage.

name: Hired Gun
notes: Crack Shot: +2 to the Kinetic, Energy or Heavy Weapon attack just made.

name: Vigilante
notes: Shotgun: 2D10 at medium range, 1D10 at long range.

name: Religious Zealot
notes: Stay Standing: an attack that just hit does not knock it down.

name: Bounty Hunter
notes: Dual Fire: fires two autopistols simultaneously at no penalty. Hard Boiled: two ranged attacks, one with each gun, at +2 To Hit; Defence (Dodge) is 10 until its next turn.

name: Unstoppable Assassin
notes: Fighting damage: 1D10 halved +8. Continuous Driving Attack. Dive Aside (×3): +5 Defence (Dodge) against an attack that would hit. Riposte (×2): can counter-attack its enemy's counter-attack. Stay Standing (×3): an attack that just hit does not knock it down.

name: Borchuck
notes: If its Slam knocks the target over, it can make a free Hoof attack on that target. Toxic Vomit does toxic damage.

name: Narseer
notes: Sickle Claw: knocked-over targets only. Sonic Screech: on a natural 9 or 10 To Hit the target is knocked over and drops whatever it was holding.

name: Gollunk
notes: Continuous Driving Attack.

name: Frenick
notes: To fire its Energy Blast it must stand still, facing the target.

name: Kai
notes: Overwhelming Assault: attacks with Bite, Claw and Tail Sting in the same turn, at the same or different enemies. Tail Sting: on a hit the target takes 5 Toxic damage per round until treated with a Difficulty 9 Medicine check.

name: Stump
notes: If its Claw hits, it may make an immediate Bite against the same target. Pounce: instead of moving, it can pounce up to 20m and then make a Claw attack, jumping over objects and people if there is room.

name: Rock Runner
notes: Bite: 2D10+4 against both individual- and vehicle-scale targets. No disadvantage over uneven ground.

name: Tengoroth
notes: Tusks: human-sized targets are knocked over. Acid Globule: explodes on impact (Fatal 8m, Injury 12m); two per day.

name: Mordrake Spider

weapons.name: Chemical Attack
weapons.notes: Only if target is knocked over.

notes: Stab: on a natural 9 or 10 To Hit the target is knocked over and drops whatever it was holding; the spider then makes a Chemical Attack. Chemical Attack: knocked-over targets only, toxic. Barbed Hairs: 2D10 at medium range, 1D10 at long range; must include up to two adjacent targets within 2m of the enemy if it can, rolling to hit each separately, friend or foe.

name: Mortis Claw
notes: Sickle Claw: attacks all targets within 2m.

name: Weaselrat
notes: Ripping Bite: damage halved; on an even roll the target bleeds 1 damage per turn until treated with a Difficulty 7 Medicine check.

name: Snakewolf
notes: Bite: on an even damage roll the target is poisoned, taking 3 toxic damage at the start of its turn until treated with a Difficulty 8 Medicine check. It flees after biting.

name: Bathawk
notes: Eye-ripping Beak: damage halved; on a 10 the target is blinded (no Skill bonuses to attacks and Skill checks) until treated with a Difficulty 8 Medicine check. Flies: ignores difficult terrain and interposing enemies.

name: Gorillalion
notes: Pummelling Slash: if both damage dice are even, the target is grabbed. Gorilla Grab: the target takes 1D10 halved damage at the start of its turn, can't move, and can only use its Action to escape (Athletics, Difficulty 11; Close Combat damage bonuses add to the roll).

name: Police Herg
notes: Hoof: it can also move 4m without provoking a free attack. Charge: must move 8m first; if it knocks the target over, it can make a free Hoof attack on that target.

name: T-90 Patrol Drone
notes: Hail of Fire: if it doesn't move, it can fire its Sub Machinegun twice. Fly: ignores difficult terrain and interposing enemies. Slow Witted: cannot take reactions. Mechanical: immune to toxic damage. No Karma.

name: Pendragon Support Drone
notes: Fly: ignores difficult terrain and interposing enemies. Slow Witted: cannot take reactions. Mechanical: immune to toxic damage. No Karma.

name: Apex-Fire Combat Drone
notes: Fly: ignores difficult terrain and interposing enemies. Slow Witted: cannot take reactions. Mechanical: immune to toxic damage. No Karma.

name: Junga Pattern Walker Drone
notes: Auto-loader: one spare clip; the Chain Gun reloads without spending an action. Slow Witted: cannot take reactions. Mechanical: immune to toxic damage. No Karma.

name: Manticore HN Walker Drone
notes: Continuous Attack (Chain Gun only). Auto-loader: one spare clip; the Chain Gun reloads without spending an action. Slow Witted: cannot take reactions. Mechanical: immune to toxic damage. No Karma.

name: Type X Walker Drone
notes: Continuous Attack (Chain Gun only). Auto-loader: one spare clip; the Chain Gun reloads without spending an action. Slow Witted: cannot take reactions. Mechanical: immune to toxic damage. No Karma.
